attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changing the ContentElement constructor to bypass the Data setter and moving the Elements.Clear() call could subtly alter cached child-element state in edge cases (e.g., constructor-based initialization no longer resets _elements), risking stale content parts/fields across the widely-used ContentElement base class."}

reason: Changing the ContentElement constructor to bypass the Data setter and moving the Elements.Clear() call could subtly alter cached child-element state in edge cases (e.g., constructor-based initialization no longer resets _elements), risking stale content parts/fields across the widely-used ContentElement base class.
